releaseGates.requirement: The clean source boundary, documentation links, credential exclusions and regression tests pass on the exported tree.
releaseGates.note: The 0.3.0-rc.8 clean export passed 991 Bun tests and 65 Python tests, with 68 and four declared native-fixture skips respectively. The current source verification records exact scope.

releaseGates.requirement: The exact frozen source, Apple Silicon Mac app and Mac ZIP pass the configured local secret and malware-signature scans. Linux artifacts require their own verified-build scan record.
releaseGates.note: The source publication has its own final export/archive scan record in the release VERIFICATION.json. No new public runtime binary is included, and historical Mac/Linux package scans do not verify this source revision as a packaged app.

releaseGates.requirement: The packaged Mac runtime starts from a fresh profile, survives restart, completes backup and restore, and performs a real research-tool and artifact round trip.
releaseGates.evidence: wired16 fresh-profile startup and persistence record
releaseGates.note: HTTP 200, one project, nine frames, 21 artifacts and 21 versions passed. The counts survived stop and restart and seed errors were zero. Backup/restore and the real research-tool round trip remain open.

releaseGates.requirement: Packaged research execution cannot read provider encryption keys, refresh tokens or other authentication credentials.
The exact Mac distributable is release-signed, notarized and accepted by Gatekeeper.
releaseGates.evidence: wired16 passes strict arm64 ad-hoc code-signature verification but is not notarized

releaseGates.requirement: Managed image, PDF, Office and OCR converters work with bounded, isolated execution and clear installation failure behavior.
The final Linux and Docker packages execute the research harness with sandbox isolation, approvals, artifacts, persistence and restore.
releaseGates.note: The final Linux x64 package passed focused and portable-package tests plus Gitleaks and ClamAV scans. The unchanged pinned ELF and helper previously ran on Ubuntu 24.04, where AppArmor blocked the namespace before service startup. The rebuilt JavaScript runtime and asset tree have not completed a native Linux research-harness run; no full harness or Docker result is claimed.

releaseGates.requirement: The supported WSL2 installation passes startup, research, artifact, persistence and sandbox checks.
Every claimed CPU and operating-system target runs the accepted verification suite.
Dictation works with documented portable dependencies rather than a private machine-specific installation.
App-owned branding, signed-out and error pages, documentation links and Japanese UI complete one packaged audit.
releaseGates.note: Checked branding transformations and focused tests pass. The complete packaged signed-out, error, help-link and Japanese walkthrough is not recorded.

releaseGates.requirement: The packaged release must activate Class 2 and complete the protected model, storage, browser, reviewed-egress and native-execution workflow without exposing protected data to an unapproved path.
releaseGates.note: Fail-closed source guards pass, but usable Class 2 operation remains under implementation and packaged validation. Disabled operation does not close this gate.

releaseGates.requirement: The distribution establishes the applicable rights for the preserved runtime and every bundled upstream component.
releaseGates.note: No categorical legal conclusion is claimed.

releaseGates.requirement: The project owner selects a distribution license for eligible new integration source.
releaseGates.note: Apache License 2.0 does not relicense the preserved runtime, bundled assets or upstream excerpts.

releaseGates.requirement: The frozen source, candidate hashes, notices, private-path exclusions and user-facing claims receive one final review.
releaseGates.note: The audit remains open until the Class 2 implementation and its exact packaged evidence are frozen and reviewed with the other release records.
